etymology.historical_story: Malay trik closely matches English trick in both form and its pairing of deception with practical ingenuity. English trick has a history reaching back through medieval French. This comparison helps explain the semantic connection, but the supplied Malay dictionary entry does not establish the immediate borrowing route or date. See [English trick: etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/trick).

etymology.historical_story: Tevye entered international popular culture through Sholem Aleichem's Yiddish stories about a dairyman navigating family life and social change. Stage and film adaptations, especially Fiddler on the Roof, carried the character to new audiences. Its appearance in a Malay text therefore need not indicate a Malay vocabulary item: it may simply identify this literary character. [Yiddish Book Center](https://www.yiddishbookcenter.org/educational-programs/resources-teachers/resource-kits-teachers/classics-yiddish-literature/tevye)

senses.zh_definition: 雷；雷声。

senses.ms_definition: Guruh atau guntur, iaitu bunyi akibat pengembangan udara yang dipanaskan oleh kilat.

senses.zh_definition: 雷鸣般的轰响；也可指声势逼人的怒吼或威吓。

senses.zh_definition: 打雷。
senses.en_definition: To produce thunder, usually with an impersonal weather subject.
senses.ms_definition: Berguruh atau mengeluarkan bunyi guruh.

senses.zh_definition: 发出雷鸣般的响声；伴随轰响快速或猛烈地移动。
senses.en_definition: To make a thunderlike noise or move with a powerful rumbling sound.
senses.ms_definition: Mengeluarkan bunyi gemuruh atau bergerak dengan bunyi yang kuat.
senses.nuances: 英语常描写车辆、马匹或重物的声势，译成马来语时通常需要同时表达移动和声音。

senses.nuances: 英语叙事用法，带鲜明情绪。马来语可根据语境译为 menengking、membentak 或 bersuara lantang。

etymology.historical_story: English thunder continues Old English thunor through Middle English forms such as thoner and thunder. Its history belongs to the Germanic vocabulary of storm sounds, rather than Malay word formation. The same English word now describes both atmospheric thunder and powerful noises or voices that resemble it. [Source](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/thunder)

etymology.historical_story: Thompson developed as a patronymic surname: Thom was a familiar form of Thomas, and son identified descent. etymology.historical_story: The sound sense of tang turns a brief metallic impact into a pronounceable syllable, much as English uses clang. Malay dictionaries connect it with dentang. They also preserve separate entries for a shortened place expression and a tool name. These overlapping spellings show how a dictionary can retain everyday sounds, older expressions and regional vocabulary without implying a single shared origin.

senses.nuances: 带有归责意味，语气比 bertanya（询问）或 mengesyaki（怀疑）更强；指控本身不说明事情已经证实。书面主动陈述通常用 menuduh。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=tuduh)

etymology.historical_story: Tuduh belongs to an established Malay word family linking everyday blame with formal accusation. Its derivatives show how the language distinguishes an act, its content, and the people involved: menuduh names the action, tuduhan the allegation, penuduh the accuser, and tertuduh the accused. This lexical history does not establish a particular foreign source or a precise date of origin.

senses.zh_definition: 哭泣；以流泪、抽泣等方式表达情绪的行为，也指由此发出的哭声。
senses.en_definition: The act or sound of crying, often expressing sadness, distress, or another strong emotion.

senses.nuances: 这是名词，常用来描写听见的哭声或情绪的流露；描述某人正在哭通常用 menangis。除悲伤外，也可用于喜悦或感动。Kamus Dewan 另记较文学性的用法，指所哀叹或渴望的对象，须依上下文判断。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tangisan)。

etymology.historical_story: Tangisan illustrates a productive Malay pattern: adding -an to tangis produces a noun for crying or its expression. The same base appears in menangis and menangisi, linking the event with the person or loss being mourned. Malay dictionaries also preserve a literary meaning referring to what is lamented or desired. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tangis).

morphology.pattern_note: 按资料包将现代词根记为 tetangga，整词学习。首音节 te- 读 /tə/；ngg 表示 /ŋɡ/。DBP 另参照 tangga，但不能据此把 te- 当作现代能自由使用的前缀。Jawi 未获核定，保留 null。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合谈邻里互助、社区活动和邻居关系。正式组织名称如 Rukun Tetangga 使用大写；邻里交往中尊重彼此隐私及生活习惯。

etymology.historical_story: DBP connects tetangga with tangga, the word for stairs or a ladder, but its advisory explanation does not establish a precise historical development. In Malaysia, the word gained a prominent public setting through Rukun Tetangga, launched in 1975. Initially focused on neighbourhood security, the programme later broadened towards neighbourly relations and community development. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tetangga), [JPNIN](https://www.jpnin.gov.my/web/kawasan-rukun-tetangga)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 tangga 楼梯旁住着邻居：tetangga＝邻居。这是记忆画面，不是已经证实的词源故事。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节独立词素，不作伪词根拆分；常与其他词组合，限定声音或颜色的具体属性。

word_family.gloss: 颜色的色调或明暗层次

senses.zh_definition: 音调；音乐声音所具有的高低或定音特征。
senses.en_definition: A musical tone or pitch.
senses.ms_definition: Laras bunyi dalam muzik.
senses.nuances: 用于音乐时，侧重声音的高低或音调属性；与表示音质的义项须按上下文区分。依据：[DBP PRPM：ton I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=ton+I)。

senses.zh_definition: 音色；声音所具有的独特质感或品质。
senses.en_definition: The distinctive quality or timbre of a sound.
senses.ms_definition: Kualiti bunyi dalam muzik.
senses.nuances: 侧重声音听起来如何，如圆润、明亮或柔和，而非单纯高低。warna ton 是音乐语境中的“音色”。依据：[DBP PRPM：ton](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=ton)。

senses.zh_definition: 色调；颜色的明暗程度，也用于描述相近颜色之间的深浅层次。
senses.en_definition: The lightness or darkness of a colour; a shade or tonal value.
senses.ms_definition: Darjah kecerahan warna.
senses.nuances: 常用于绘画、摄影、服装及设计。给定词包对应 ton I；此处不混入另列的印尼荷兰语源货币俗称。一般马来西亚计量语境中的“吨”写作 tan。颜色用法与计量区别见 [DBP PRPM：ton](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ton)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pasukan reka bentuk mencadangkan penggunaan ton warna yang lebih cerah untuk ruang penerimaan tetamu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 设计团队建议接待区采用更明亮的色调。
dual_scenarios.en: The design team recommends lighter colour tones for the reception area.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Ton biru ni cantik lah, ambil yang ni je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Ton biru ini cantik; pilih yang ini sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这个蓝色调挺好看的，就选这个吧。
dual_scenarios.en: This shade of blue looks lovely. Let's go with this one.
spoken_features: ni 对应 ini。
lah 在此表达赞同或欣赏。
je 对应 sahaja。
ambil 在挑选商品时表示选择。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Awak nak ton biru yang ni ke yang gelap tu?
messages.ms_standard: Awak mahu ton biru yang ini atau ton biru yang gelap itu?
messages.zh: 你想要这个蓝色调，还是那个深一点的？
messages.en: Do you want this shade of blue or that darker one?

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Yang ni je lah, nampak cerah sikit.
messages.ms_standard: Saya pilih yang ini sahaja kerana warnanya kelihatan sedikit lebih cerah.
messages.zh: 就这个吧，看起来亮一点。
messages.en: Let's go with this one. It looks a little lighter.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 评价演奏或设计时，可具体说 ton terlalu tinggi 或 ton warna agak gelap，聚焦作品属性。讨论他人的说话态度时，nada suara 通常更直接清楚。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于音乐教学、录音讨论、绘画和配色交流。涉及肤色时宜保持客观，避免把深浅色调与人的价值、身份或美丑直接挂钩。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 评价演奏或设计时，可具体说 ton terlalu tinggi 或 ton warna agak gelap，聚焦作品属性。讨论他人的说话态度时，nada suara 通常更直接清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于音乐教学、录音讨论、绘画和配色交流。涉及肤色时宜保持客观，避免把深浅色调与人的价值、身份或美丑直接挂钩。

etymology.historical_story: Ton provides a useful bridge between the arts. In music, it can identify pitch or the quality of a sound; in painting and design, it identifies degrees of colour brightness. The musical expression warna ton, literally tone colour, makes that bridge especially memorable: a sound can be described through the vocabulary of colour. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=ton).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 tone 联想 ton：耳朵听音调、音色，眼睛看色调；说“吨”则记 tan。

morphology.pattern_note: -kan 构成使动及物形式；词根末尾 k 与后缀开头 k 均保留，写作 kk。常用于祈使句，也用于 saya tundukkan 等第一人称被动结构；普通主动陈述通常用 menundukkan。资料包的 jawi 是词根拼写，完整词形为 توندوقکن。

word_family.gloss: 使低下或使屈服的行为

senses.zh_definition: 使头或脸向下、向前低垂；也指将目光朝下。
senses.en_definition: To lower or bow the head, or direct the gaze downward.
senses.ms_definition: Menggerakkan kepala atau muka supaya menghala ke bawah atau ke hadapan, atau mengarahkan pandangan ke bawah.
senses.nuances: 祈使句通常带宾语，如 tundukkan kepala。tunduk 可直接表示人低头；tundukkan 则明确使某个身体部位或目光向下。身体动作义据 [DBP：tunduk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tunduk) 整理。

senses.zh_definition: 击败、制服或征服对手，使其失去抵抗能力或认输。
senses.en_definition: To defeat, subdue or bring an opponent into submission.
senses.ms_definition: Mengatasi pihak lawan sehingga tewas, menyerah atau berada di bawah kekuasaan pihak lain.
senses.nuances: 可用于体育竞争，也可用于军事征服；体育语境不表示对手必须正式投降。命令或口号可用 tundukkan，普通主动新闻陈述多用 menundukkan。相关义项见 [DBP：tunduk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tunduk)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pegawai keselamatan memberikan arahan, “Sila tundukkan kepala semasa melalui pintu yang rendah ini.”
dual_scenarios.zh: 安全员指示：“通过这扇较低的门时，请低头。”
dual_scenarios.en: The safety officer instructed, “Please lower your head when passing through this low doorway.”

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tundukkan kepala sikit, pintu ni rendah je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Tundukkan kepala sedikit kerana pintu ini rendah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 头低一点，这门挺矮的。
dual_scenarios.en: Duck your head a little—the doorway's low.
spoken_features: sikit 对应 sedikit，ni 对应 ini。
je 在此带随意的语气，标准改写无需机械保留。
祈使句省略第二人称主语。
tundukkan 保留后缀 -kan，后接明确宾语 kepala。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tundukkan kepala sikit, pintu ni rendah je.
messages.ms_standard: Tundukkan kepala sedikit kerana pintu ini rendah.
messages.zh: 头低一点，这门挺矮的。
messages.en: Duck your head a little—the doorway's low.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Oh, nasib baik kau bagitahu. Tadi aku nak masuk terus je.
messages.ms_standard: Oh, mujurlah awak memberitahu saya. Tadi saya hendak terus masuk.
messages.zh: 哦，还好你提醒我，我刚才差点直接走进去。
messages.en: Oh, good thing you warned me. I was about to walk straight in.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说 Tundukkan kepala! 是命令；礼貌提醒可加 sila，或用 Tolong tundukkan kepala sedikit。紧急避险时直接提醒很自然。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 低头可能出于安全、礼貌、羞怯或宗教礼仪，应按场景理解。tundukkan pandangan 在宗教语境可涉及目光礼仪；对人使用征服义可能显得强硬，不适合作为普通职场协作措辞。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接说 Tundukkan kepala! 是命令；礼貌提醒可加 sila，或用 Tolong tundukkan kepala sedikit。紧急避险时直接提醒很自然。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 低头可能出于安全、礼貌、羞怯或宗教礼仪，应按场景理解。tundukkan pandangan 在宗教语境可涉及目光礼仪；对人使用征服义可能显得强硬，不适合作为普通职场协作措辞。

etymology.historical_story: Tundukkan illustrates how a bodily action can support a wider metaphor. Tunduk describes a lowered head and also submission; adding -kan produces a transitive form meaning to make something lower or make an opponent yield. These connected senses are recorded in [DBP's tunduk entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tunduk), without establishing which meaning historically came first.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tunduk＝低头；加 -kan＝使……低下：让头低下是“低头”，让对手低头是“击败”。

morphology.pattern_note: 首音节 te 的 e 读央元音 /ə/。派生时，meN- 或 peN- 在 t 前采用鼻音 n，并使词首 t 脱落，如 meneguhkan、peneguhan。

senses.zh_definition: 结构坚固、结实，或连接牢靠，不容易损坏、倒塌或松脱。
senses.en_definition: Sturdy, firmly constructed, or securely fastened.
senses.ms_definition: Kukuh binaan atau ikatannya sehingga tidak mudah rosak, roboh atau terurai.
senses.nuances: 用于建筑、材料、支撑和捆绑，强调稳定与牢靠；不是所有表示力度大的 kuat 都能换成 teguh。各义马来语释义依据 DBP 内容归纳。[DBP：teguh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=teguh)

senses.zh_definition: 关系紧密而稳固，不容易疏远或破裂。
senses.en_definition: Strong and enduring, of a relationship or social bond.
senses.ms_definition: Erat dan tidak mudah terputus, khususnya tentang hubungan antara manusia.
senses.nuances: 这是由物理牢固延伸出的比喻义，强调关系经得起考验；亲密而轻松的日常关系也常用 rapat 或 akrab。

collocations.zh: 牢固的亲情或手足情谊

senses.zh_definition: 经济、财政等保持强健和稳定，没有明显衰退。
senses.en_definition: Strong and stable, especially economically or financially.
senses.ms_definition: Kukuh dan tidak merosot, terutama tentang keadaan ekonomi atau kewangan.
senses.nuances: 常见于经济报道和机构汇报。表示整体稳健，不必然表示正在高速增长。

senses.zh_definition: 信念、立场、意志或忠诚坚定，不轻易改变或动摇。
senses.en_definition: Firm, steadfast, or unwavering in conviction, resolve, or loyalty.
senses.ms_definition: Tetap dan tidak mudah goyah dalam pendirian, keazaman, kepercayaan atau kesetiaan.
senses.nuances: 通常带肯定评价，强调坚持。berpegang teguh pada 表示坚守某项原则或承诺；不等于表示不讲道理的固执。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Syarikat itu kekal teguh dari segi kewangan walaupun berdepan dengan peningkatan kos operasi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 尽管营运成本上升，该公司的财务状况依然稳健。
dual_scenarios.en: The company remains financially sound despite rising operating costs.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau masih teguh dengan keputusan tu ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu masih teguh dengan keputusan itu?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你还是坚持那个决定吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Are you still standing by that decision?
spoken_features: kau 是熟人之间使用的第二人称。
tu 是 itu 的口语形式。
句末 ke 表示疑问；teguh 在此比一般口语 tetap 更强调立场坚定。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau masih teguh dengan keputusan tu ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu masih teguh dengan keputusan itu?
messages.zh: 你还是坚持那个决定吗？
messages.en: Are you still standing by that decision?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, aku dah fikir masak-masak. Aku nak teruskan juga.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya sudah mempertimbangkannya dengan teliti. Saya tetap mahu meneruskannya.
messages.zh: 对，我已经想清楚了，还是想继续。
messages.en: Yes, I've thought it through. I still want to go ahead.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 赞扬他人立场或意志时通常得体。涉及宗教信仰或忠诚时，避免用它衡量、质疑他人的人格。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合演讲、鼓励、新闻和正式评价。肯定坚持原则时用 teguh；需要表达愿意协商时，可同时说明 terbuka untuk berbincang，以免让语气显得拒绝沟通。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 赞扬他人立场或意志时通常得体。涉及宗教信仰或忠诚时，避免用它衡量、质疑他人的人格。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合演讲、鼓励、新闻和正式评价。肯定坚持原则时用 teguh；需要表达愿意协商时，可同时说明 terbuka untuk berbincang，以免让语气显得拒绝沟通。

etymology.historical_story: Malay imagery connects physical strength with moral constancy. The dictionary illustrates teguh through a tree whose many roots help it withstand storms, then extends the same idea to friendship, economic strength, and resolve. This provides a cultural pathway through its meanings: what stands securely in the material world becomes a model for what endures in human affairs.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 te-guh 的短促节奏联想成把木桩敲牢：桩站得稳，叫 teguh；立场站得稳，也叫 teguh。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整的外来体育名词记忆，无可分离的马来语词缀。首音节的 e 为 e taling /e/，不是 /ə/；té 仅用于标示读音，普通拼写仍为 tenis。词族列出常用组合。

senses.zh_definition: 网球：两人或两对选手在中间设网的球场上，用球拍将球击向对方场地的运动。
senses.en_definition: A racket sport in which two players or two pairs hit a ball over a net into the opposing court.
senses.ms_definition: Permainan antara dua orang atau dua pasangan yang menggunakan raket untuk memukul bola melintasi jaring di tengah gelanggang.
senses.nuances: 单独使用 tenis 通常指网球。tenis meja 在《Kamus Dewan》中标为印度尼西亚用语，对应乒乓球；马来西亚日常通常说 pingpong。读音及释义参见 [DBP：tenis](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=tenis)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kejohanan tenis antara jabatan akan berlangsung di kompleks sukan pada hujung minggu ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 部门间网球锦标赛将于本周末在体育中心举行。
dual_scenarios.en: The interdepartmental tennis championship will take place at the sports complex this weekend.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Esok petang nak main tenis kat kelab tak?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu mahu bermain tenis di kelab esok petang?
dual_scenarios.zh: 明天下午要不要去俱乐部打网球？
dual_scenarios.en: Want to play tennis at the club tomorrow afternoon?
spoken_features: nak 对应 mahu 或 hendak
main 是 bermain 的常见口语形式
kat 在此对应地点介词 di
句末 tak 构成口语的是非问句

messages.ms_spoken: Esok petang nak main tenis kat kelab tak? Aku dah tempah gelanggang.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu mahu bermain tenis di kelab esok petang? Saya sudah menempah gelanggang.

messages.en: I'm in! But I've only just started learning tennis, so let's take it easy.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: tenis 属于中性词，正式和日常场景都适用。邀请长辈或不熟悉的人时，可说 Adakah tuan atau puan berminat untuk bermain tenis?
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 约球时说明时间、场地及大致水平，方便对方安排。面对初学者，可用 main santai 表示轻松练习；讨论乒乓球时，在马来西亚使用 pingpong 通常更自然。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: tenis 属于中性词，正式和日常场景都适用。邀请长辈或不熟悉的人时，可说 Adakah tuan atau puan berminat untuk bermain tenis?
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 约球时说明时间、场地及大致水平，方便对方安排。面对初学者，可用 main santai 表示轻松练习；讨论乒乓球时，在马来西亚使用 pingpong 通常更自然。

etymology.historical_story: Tenis is the Malay form of the international sporting name tennis. The English name is commonly connected with French tenez, a call associated with serving, although the historical explanation is not entirely certain. The sport developed from earlier French handball games into racket games and later lawn tennis. See the [International Tennis Federation's history](https://www.itftennis.com/en/news-and-media/articles/history-of-tennis/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tenis 看起来、读起来都接近英语 tennis：英语两个 n，马来语一个 n，记住同一支网球拍。

morphology.pattern_note: ter-直接接在kurung前，词根首音k保留；此处主要表示受困的状态或结果，不表示最高级，也不必然表示意外。

senses.zh_definition: 被关住或困在封闭、受围困的空间内，无法自由离开。
senses.en_definition: To be confined, enclosed, imprisoned, or trapped within a space.
senses.ms_definition: Terpenjara, terkongkong, tertutup atau terlengkung di dalam sesuatu ruang, atau terkepung.
senses.nuances: 属于状态性动词，侧重无法离开的处境；可以由意外、环境或他人的行为造成。dikurung更直接突出被关押这一行为，terperangkap还可用于陷阱等不一定封闭的环境。[DBP释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=terkurung)

senses.zh_definition: 在思想、生活或行动上受到束缚，缺乏自由或开阔的视野。
senses.en_definition: To be restricted in one's freedom, outlook, or way of life.
senses.ms_definition: Terkongkong dari segi kebebasan, kehidupan atau pemikiran; dalam ungkapan terkurung fahamnya, sempit pengetahuan atau pemikirannya.
senses.nuances: 由空间受困引申为抽象束缚。terkurung fahamnya是词典记录的较旧表达，现代交流更常说pemikirannya sempit；批评性较强。[DBP释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=terkurung)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Anggota bomba berjaya menyelamatkan tiga orang pekerja yang terkurung di dalam lif selepas bekalan elektrik terputus.
dual_scenarios.zh: 停电后，消防人员成功救出了被困在电梯内的三名员工。

etymology.historical_story: Terkurung combines kurung, the idea of enclosure, with ter-, presenting confinement as a state. A Malay proverb recorded by DBP compares lost freedom to a bird whose eyes can roam while its body remains confined. That image explains the word's expressive reach: walls may contain a body, while circumstances or narrow thinking can constrain a life. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=terkurung)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把kurung想成围栏：ter- + kurung就是“已经落在围栏里的状态”——被关住、出不去；词尾ng读/ŋ/。

etymology.historical_story: Taliban comes from Pashto tālibān, the plural of tālib, meaning a student or seeker. The singular ultimately derives from Arabic. The movement's name reflects its association with religious students, but modern Malay uses Taliban as an organizational proper name. Its final -an therefore belongs to the source language, rather than Malay noun formation. [Open Pashto-English Dictionary](https://oped.univie.ac.at/oped.php?alph=3&dev=1&dir=1&entry=28824&how=2&let=&nons=0&what=1), [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=taliban)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ta-li-ban 对应中文“塔利班”；记住它是完整组织名称，末尾 -an 不作马来语后缀拆分。

etymology.historical_story: Terharu is transparently related to haru within Malay, alongside mengharukan and keharuan. Its dictionary meanings connect emotional tenderness with an unsettled heart or mind. This makes it useful for describing compassion and deeply affecting experiences. The visible prefix explains its modern formation; it does not, by itself, establish a particular foreign origin. [DBP word family and meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=terharu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ter-ha-ru 分成三拍，联想“心被触动，话也停了一拍”：terharu 是自己受到触动，mengharukan 是事情令人动容。

morphology.pattern_note: 阿拉伯语整词借入，在现代马来语中作为词根使用；tak- 不是此词中的否定词缀。常见本地读音把首音节末读成 [ʔ]，亦可听到保留 [k] 或接近阿拉伯语 [ʕ] 的读法。缺失的音节信息据常见读音补全。

senses.nuances: 主要用于丧亲场景。单独说 Takziah 也能构成完整慰问，但词类仍为名词。它表达对悲痛的体恤，不意味着说话者与对方拥有同一宗教。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 致哀宜简短、真诚，不追问死亡细节，也不催促对方振作或回复。对长辈或不熟的人可说 Saya mengucapkan takziah kepada anda sekeluarga。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: Takziah 可向不同宗教背景的丧亲者表达。是否加入特定宗教祷词，应尊重对方信仰；不确定时可用 Salam takziah buat seisi keluarga。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 致哀宜简短、真诚，不追问死亡细节，也不催促对方振作或回复。对长辈或不熟的人可说 Saya mengucapkan takziah kepada anda sekeluarga。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: Takziah 可向不同宗教背景的丧亲者表达。是否加入特定宗教祷词，应尊重对方信仰；不确定时可用 Salam takziah buat seisi keluarga。

etymology.historical_story: Takziah comes from Arabic taʿziya, meaning consolation or condolence. Malay treats the borrowed word as a noun and adds its own prefix in bertakziah. Its familiar use shows how vocabulary associated with Islamic tradition also serves everyday human relationships: offering sympathy to a grieving family requires care, presence, and very few words. [Etymology: takziah](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/takziah#Malay); [DBP: takziah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=takziah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 轻声读 tak-zi-ah，想象停下脚步、向悲伤的人致意：一句 Takziah，表达“我为你的失去感到难过”。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接基底 teruskan；更深层词根为 terus。-kan 构成动词形式，-lah 是后附强调小品词，此处归入 suffix 仅为适配字段；连接时无词干音变，标准拼写连写。

senses.zh_definition: 继续吧；请接着进行某项活动、工作、行程或叙述。

senses.ms_definition: Bentuk perintah bagi meneruskan, iaitu melanjutkan atau menyambung sesuatu kegiatan, dengan partikel penegas -lah.
senses.nuances: 常用于鼓励、准许或要求对方继续。宾语可明说，也可由语境补足；-lah 可使语气柔和，也可加强催促，须结合语调判断。此释义根据 [DBP 的 terus／meneruskan 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=terus)与 [DBP 的小品词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penegas)综合编写，并非独立词条的逐字引文。

senses.zh_definition: 请将信件、文件或信息直接转交、转发给指定对象。
senses.en_definition: Forward or pass something on to a specified recipient, expressed as an instruction or request.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk perintah yang meminta sesuatu surat, dokumen atau maklumat disampaikan terus kepada penerima tertentu.
senses.nuances: 通常出现 teruskanlah + 所转交之物 + kepada + 接收者的结构。此义取决于宾语和接收者，不能将所有 teruskanlah 都译作“转发”。依据 [DBP 的 meneruskan 转交义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=terus)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合请人继续发言、工作或行程。语调强硬时可能带催促甚至不耐烦；正式第三人称叙述通常依句法使用 meneruskan 或 diteruskan。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 语调温和时可表达鼓励或礼貌准许；对上级、长辈或客户，可加称谓或 silakan，例如 Silakan, puan, teruskanlah。-lah 本身不保证礼貌。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合请人继续发言、工作或行程。语调强硬时可能带催促甚至不耐烦；正式第三人称叙述通常依句法使用 meneruskan 或 diteruskan。

etymology.historical_story: Teruskanlah illustrates Malay word formation in everyday interaction. The base terus contributes continuity, -kan forms the verb used in the instruction teruskan, and -lah adds discourse emphasis. DBP describes -lah as a bound emphatic particle. Its conversational effect depends on context and intonation, allowing the same form to invite, encourage, or insist. 来源：[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penegas)。

etymology.historical_story: Taksi belongs to the international taxi word family, whose name developed from the taximeter used to calculate fares. A measuring device thus supplied the familiar vehicle name. Indonesian uses taksi, while Malaysian Malay normally uses teksi. The international history is outlined by [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/taxi); the regional distinction is recorded by [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=teksi).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: taksi 听起来接近英语 taxi：把拼写 x 展开成 ks，就容易记住“出租车”。马来西亚常用形式另记为 teksi。

senses.en_definition: A light, clear metallic ringing sound, like a small bell or a coin striking the floor; also an imitation of that sound.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi seperti loceng kecil atau wang logam yang jatuh ke lantai.
senses.nuances: 核心是短促、清脆的响声，不泛指所有铃声或巨大的撞击声。此处以声音名词标注；直接写作 ting! 时起拟声作用。[DBP：ting](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=ting)

etymology.historical_story: Ting is best understood through sound imitation rather than a speculative borrowing history. Its compact shape evokes a brief metallic ring. DBP illustrates the sound with a small bell and a coin falling to the floor, giving learners two familiar listening scenes. No particular inventor or first-use date is established here. [DBP: ting](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=ting)

etymology.historical_story: English toilet comes from French toilette, a diminutive of toile, meaning cloth. Its history connects cloth and dressing-table equipment with washing, dressing and eventually lavatory facilities. The modern sanitary meaning is the relevant one in Malaysian conversation; the older grooming senses should not automatically be imported into a Malay learner's everyday usage. [Etymonline: toilet](https://www.etymonline.com/word/toilet)

etymology.historical_story: Tobias reached European naming traditions through Greek and Latin forms of a Hebrew personal name associated with divine goodness. Its biblical background helped the name travel between languages, producing different pronunciations and related forms. That history belongs to the name itself; it does not establish the religion, nationality, or family background of any particular bearer. [Source](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Tobias)

messages.ms_standard: Ini rezeki yang tidak tersangka, bukan? Saya baru sahaja hendak membeli buku itu.

etymology.historical_story: Tersangka is transparently formed from ter- and sangka. Its dictionary meanings connect two kinds of uncertain thought: anticipating something and suspecting someone. A useful regional development appears in Indonesian, where tersangka also functions as a noun for a suspect. Malaysian learners therefore need both the shared word family and awareness of regional usage. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tersangka).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 sangka＝猜想；tersangka＝被想到、被怀疑。再把 tidak 加上：tidak tersangka＝没料到。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，在马来语中可作为英语引语或语码转换成分出现；/aʊ/ 为双元音。不得与马来语 tahun 混淆。以下词族属于英语。

senses.zh_definition: 英语名词：城镇，通常比村庄大、比城市小的聚居地。
senses.en_definition: A settlement usually larger than a village and smaller than a city.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris yang merujuk petempatan yang lazimnya lebih besar daripada kampung tetapi lebih kecil daripada bandar raya; padanannya bergantung pada konteks, seperti pekan atau bandar.
senses.nuances: 输入未提供 DBP 马来语释义；此处是英语词义及编辑撰写的马来语解释，不是 DBP 官方定义。status 按指定结构保留，不表示该词已获认定为规范马来语。搭配为可在混合语境中出现的英语词组。参见 [Cambridge：town](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/town)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语或混合口语中的市区、镇中心，尤指商店和商业活动集中的地方。
senses.en_definition: The central shopping or business area of a town or city.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian pusat sesebuah bandar atau pekan, khususnya kawasan kedai dan kegiatan perniagaan.
senses.nuances: 在去购物、办事等语境中，town 常指市区而非独立的小镇；正式马来语可按语境用 pusat bandar 或 pusat pekan。[Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/town) 收录此英语义项。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟悉英语的朋友之间可以自然夹用；对不熟悉英语的听者，使用 bandar、pekan 或 pusat bandar 更清楚。

etymology.historical_story: English town descends from Old English tūn, which could denote an enclosure, village, or town. Its earlier meanings connect a bounded space with a settled community. In Malay conversation, using town illustrates switching into English; the supplied packet does not establish when it entered any particular Malaysian speech community. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/town).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: town /taʊn/ 一拍读完，联想“到市区逛一趟”；不要读成两音节的 tahun“年”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根本身不带词缀。派生 menata 时，meN- 在 /t/ 前实现为 men-，词根首音 /t/ 脱落；口语告别语 tata 是另一个同形词。

senses.zh_definition: 规则、程序、方法或有条理的安排；组织事物的秩序或体系。
senses.en_definition: An order, arrangement, procedure, or system governing how things are organized.
senses.ms_definition: Peraturan, acara, kaedah, susunan, sistem.
senses.nuances: 此义单独使用偏书面语；日常表达通常选用 aturan、susunan 或 sistem。学习者更常在 tatacara、tatatertib、tatabahasa 等合写形式中遇到 tata。以下列出含此构词成分的常见搭配，而非把复合词误写成分开的 tata cara 或 tata tertib。

senses.zh_definition: 再见；拜拜，尤用于儿童或对儿童说话的场合。
senses.en_definition: Bye-bye; an informal expression of farewell, especially associated with children.
senses.ms_definition: Selamat tinggal atau selamat jalan, biasanya diucapkan oleh kanak-kanak sambil menggamit.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 另列的同形词 tata II，与“秩序、体系”的 tata I 分开理解。常伴随挥手，语气亲昵，不适合正式公函的结尾。[DBP：tata](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=tata)

dual_scenarios.en: During the training session, the officer explained that tata refers to rules, arrangements, or a system.

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: “秩序”义适合语言说明、制度讨论及文学表达。不要把印尼语中常见的分写形式直接套入马来西亚规范拼写；例如马来西亚通常写 tatabahasa、tatacara、tatatertib。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 说明制度或程序时，用完整词 tatacara 或 tatatertib 更自然。告别义 tata 带儿童化、亲昵色彩；对客户、长辈或正式对象告别，可用 selamat jalan、selamat tinggal 或符合情境的问候。

etymology.historical_story: Malay tata connects the idea of order with the practical work of arranging things. Its dictionary family includes menata, penataan, and penata: arranging, arrangement, and arranger. A separate dictionary entry records the affectionate farewell tata, especially associated with children. These identical spellings therefore lead into two different cultural settings: organized activity and friendly leave-taking. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=tata)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ta-ta 想成排队时两下整齐的踏步声：一步一格，有规则、有次序。告别义则联想挥手说“拜拜”。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中按不可再分析的借入形容词处理；词尾 -is 不是此词中的马来语派生后缀。tra 保留词首辅音组合 /tr/。下列词为相关借词，不是由 tragis 添加词缀生成。

senses.zh_definition: 极其悲惨、令人深感悲痛的；具有悲剧色彩的。
senses.en_definition: Deeply distressing or sorrowful; tragic.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat sedih atau sangat menyedihkan.
senses.nuances: 可形容遭遇、事件或故事结局，不要求一定涉及死亡。Kamus Dewan 标注 IB，即印度尼西亚语—荷兰语来源；DBP 说明其含义与 tragik 相近。这里保留该来源标签，不把它解释为马来西亚用语禁忌。参见 [DBP：tragis](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399076&keyword=tragis)及 [DBP：tragis 与 tragik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tragedi)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论真实死亡、灾难或受害者时，宜保持克制，并尊重当事人的尊严。tragis 表达强烈悲痛，适合庄重叙述。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于新闻、文学、影视评论和日常感叹。朋友间可能夸张地用来形容糟糕结果，但在真实受害者或家属面前，这种玩笑容易显得轻率。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论真实死亡、灾难或受害者时，宜保持克制，并尊重当事人的尊严。tragis 表达强烈悲痛，适合庄重叙述。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan labels tragis as Indonesian–Dutch, recording a borrowing connection rather than a native Malay affix pattern. DBP also compares it with tragik, which has closely similar meaning. The word therefore offers a small window into contact between regional languages and European vocabulary, while functioning today as an ordinary adjective for profound sorrow. See [DBP's explanation](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tragedi).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tragis 与英语 tragic 联想：看到 trag-，想到让人心痛的悲剧结局。这是记忆联想，不是直接借自英语的词源断言。

morphology.pattern_note: ter- 与 padam 直接接合，词首 p 保留。此处 ter- 可表示进入熄灭或消失的状态、非故意发生的结果，或能够被消除；具体解释依语境决定，不表示最高级。资料包未提供音节，故保留 null；所给 Jawi ڤادم 对应 padam，未包含 ter-。

word_family.gloss: 熄灭、关闭或删除的行为

senses.zh_definition: 火焰、灯光等熄灭或停止发光；可暗示意外发生。
senses.en_definition: To go out or become extinguished, sometimes unexpectedly.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi tidak bernyala atau tidak bercahaya lagi, kadangkala tanpa disengajakan.
senses.nuances: 主语通常是 api、lampu 等；不等同于主动“把某物关掉”的 memadamkan。ter- 不保证一定是误操作，也可突出已经发生的结果。释义依据 padam 的基础义及 ter- 的构词功能编写。参见 [DBP：padam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=padam)。

senses.zh_definition: 文字、图像或电子资料被擦除、删去或意外清除。
senses.en_definition: To be erased or deleted, especially unintentionally.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi hilang atau terhapus, khususnya tulisan, imej atau data, sama ada secara tidak sengaja atau akibat sesuatu tindakan.
senses.nuances: 适用于实体书写和电子资料。fail terpadam 常暗示文件意外被删；若要中性说明有人删除文件，fail dipadam 更明确。不要把所有文件遗失、损坏或无法打开的情况都称为 terpadam。

senses.zh_definition: 记忆、感情或希望等消失、被抹去；在否定结构中也表示无法被消除。
senses.en_definition: To fade or be effaced figuratively; in negative constructions, to be capable of being erased.
senses.ms_definition: Hilang atau lenyap secara kiasan, seperti kenangan atau harapan; dalam binaan tertentu, dapat dihilangkan atau dilenyapkan.
senses.nuances: 常见于 tidak terpadam 或 tidak akan terpadam，表达难以或永不磨灭。此时 ter- 可有可能性解释，并不表示“不小心忘记”。比喻用法承接 padam 的“消失、消退”义。参见 [DBP：padam 的引申义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=padam)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: terpadam 常把焦点放在结果，适合先说明事故。但若需要承担责任，应补充原因，例如 Fail itu terpadam kerana saya tersalah menekan butang，避免让人觉得在回避责任。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于灯火熄灭、资料删除和记忆消退等语境。正式事故说明应交代对象、原因及恢复情况；在表达纪念或哀思时，kenangan yang tidak terpadam 带有庄重、抒情的色彩。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: terpadam 常把焦点放在结果，适合先说明事故。但若需要承担责任，应补充原因，例如 Fail itu terpadam kerana saya tersalah menekan butang，避免让人觉得在回避责任。

etymology.historical_story: The meanings of padam connect extinguished light with disappearance more generally. Terpadam applies that vocabulary to a resulting state, including erased writing and deleted files. Figurative memories can likewise resist being extinguished. These connections explain the word's range without requiring a separate origin for its digital use. See [DBP: padam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=padam).

etymology.historical_story: English dictionaries record talbot as a historical hound name, while capitalized Talbot also occurs as a personal name. These uses should not be collapsed into one Malay meaning. A notable bearer, William Henry Fox Talbot, developed the calotype photographic process. That biographical connection explains some occurrences of the name, but the supplied packet cannot identify which meaning produced this entry. [V&A: William Henry Fox Talbot](https://www.vam.ac.uk/articles/william-henry-fox-talbot-an-introduction).

etymology.historical_story: The traditional mattress behind this word was a cloth casing stuffed with kapok or similar material. DBP also records stitched mattresses whose filling was held compact by sewing. These details preserve an older material culture of bedding within an everyday modern word. The consulted entry does not establish the word's ultimate linguistic origin. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=tilam).

etymology.historical_story: Taiwan's name carries traces of an earlier southwestern coastal geography. Historical European maps used spellings such as Tayouan for the area around present-day Anping, while Chinese records used several corresponding written forms. The name later acquired its wider island reference. The precise Indigenous derivation requires care; the Malay form should be learned as a complete place name. [Source: Indigenous Peoples Encyclopedia](https://indigenapedia-alcd.nccu.edu.tw/detail?cat=0&id=11581&race=0&search=&writer=).

etymology.historical_story: Terindah has a transparent Malay formation: the adjective indah receives ter-, marking the highest degree of a quality. Its emotional reach comes from context, allowing physical beauty to become the beauty of remembered experience. This is productive word formation, not evidence for a separate ancient root. The analysis follows [DBP’s adjective entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=indah) and [superlative guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ter+indah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: indah 是“美”，ter- 把程度推到顶：ter- + indah → “美到最高级”，即“最美的”。

etymology.historical_story: Terlanggar is transparently formed from langgar and the Malay prefix ter-. Its dictionary senses connect physical contact with the crossing of social boundaries: someone can strike an object or breach a prohibition. This offers a useful cultural connection between bodily movement and acceptable conduct, without requiring an unverified story about the root’s distant origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 langgar 想成“撞过去”，前面加 ter-，记住常见画面：“一不留神撞上了”；规则和禁忌也能被“撞破”。

morphology.pattern_note: ter- 表示承受痛苦后的状态，并非表示“不小心折磨”。词根中的 é 读 /e/；依所给词典读音，音节末 k 实现为喉塞音 /ʔ/。

senses.zh_definition: 遭受或处于折磨、痛楚、困苦之中；既可指身体受苦，也可指精神煎熬。

senses.ms_definition: (Telah) mengalami seksa, kesengsaraan atau kesakitan; telah diseksa.

etymology.historical_story: Seksa belongs to Malay’s Sanskrit-derived vocabulary and is associated with śikṣā, a word connected with instruction, discipline, and chastisement. Crawfurd’s 1852 dictionary already records seksa as punishment or chastisement. In modern terseksa, attention falls on the sufferer’s condition, which can include emotional anguish as well as inflicted pain. See [Crawfurd’s dictionary](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: seksa 是“折磨”，terseksa 是“身在折磨中”；把 ter- 记成结果状态，避免误解成“无意中折磨别人”。

etymology.historical_story: English thank comes through Middle English from Old English thancian, associated with thanc, meaning gratitude. It therefore has an English history rather than a Malay derivational history. In a Malay conversation, thank you can function as an English insertion; its presence does not establish thank as a standard Malay headword. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/thank).

etymology.historical_story: Teknikalnya combines an international technical vocabulary item with the Malay ending -nya. The English cognate technical ultimately draws on Greek words for craft and skilled practice. Malay speakers use the whole borrowed base teknikal before adding local grammatical material; its final letters are not an independently productive Malay suffix. [Merriam-Webster: technical](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/technical).

etymology.historical_story: In English, twitter describes the short, high sounds made by birds and can also describe rapid chatter. As a social media name, it invites a memorable comparison between brief posts and small bursts of sound. The service is now called X, but Twitter remains useful when discussing its earlier identity or understanding older conversations and documents. [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/twitter)
